EPA post-release flushing screening case family: This governed reference case family anchors post-release flushing and retained-mass decline against EPA environmental model evaluation principles for time-varying screening scenarios.

OECD post-release recovery screening case family: This governed reference case family anchors post-release recovery interpretation against OECD degradation-and-accumulation reporting concepts for deterministic screening models.

EPA post-release recovery directionality case family: This governed reference case family anchors reviewer-facing interpretation of how retained release-stop mass should progress as the post-release recovery window moves from below the one-turnover flushing boundary to beyond it.

EPA post-release combined-loss recovery pace case family: This governed reference case family anchors reviewer-facing interpretation of how quickly retained release-stop mass should halve under the combined degradation-plus-clearance loss constant in a flowing-water screening model.
